notes: ⌘Q now asks before it throws away a render — the last two builds only asked when you closed the window. “Rotate it 5 degrees” used to turn the picture a full 90°; Crisp turns in quarter turns and now says so, as it does for “straighten it”. And five plain requests that got “I didn’t catch an edit” are answered properly: saving as WebM or AVI explains that Crisp writes MP4 and MOV, “cut off the bottom” explains the crops it has, “thumbnail from the middle” grabs the middle frame, “fix the levels” evens out the sound, and “make it emailable” compresses.
